title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1973-11-11
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Samplitude Professional v9.02 -> Cool Edit Pro v2.01 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (44.1k) D

ai_review.summary: Pitch‑corrected soundboard capture of the legendary 11/11/73 Winterland show, featuring a scorching Dark Star and an all‑out first set that still thrills listeners.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean, pitch‑corrected soundboard mix that lets every nuance shine, from Jerry’s melodic phrasing to Phil’s jaw‑dropping solo in the Dark Star.  Fans rave about the high‑energy first set – Bertha, China>Rider and a tear‑jerking “Lay Me Down” – and a second set highlighted by an iconic Dark Star, Uncle John’s Band and The Eyes of the World.  Overall the performance is described as one of the best of ’73 with a vivid, high‑vibe atmosphere.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently glowing reviews (12+ five‑star comments) praise both the musical performance and the pristine soundboard source; only one anomalous low rating, so overall rating is near‑excellent.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Pitch‑corrected, crystal‑clear mix with no reported dropouts or distortion; reviewers call it “Excellent soundboard” and note the clean, detailed capture of instruments.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as gorgeous and high‑energy, featuring strong transitions; second set deepens the vibe with a “creepy” Dark Star and seamless segues that keep the momentum soaring.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for his melodic phrasing, tone, and overall leadership on guitar throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: His solo in Dark Star is singled out as a “wicked jam” that left listeners awestruck.
